title: CRISPR Editing of Human iPS Cells with RNPs Using Nucleofection
author: Synthego
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.srred56
materials: Aspirate Matrigel® Matrix from the plates after coating.

steps.title: Culture iPS cells on Matrigel
steps.instruction: Plate human iPS cells on Matrigel® Matrix‑coated dishes and grow until they reach semiconfluence.

steps.title: Coat new 6‑well plate
steps.instruction: Coat a fresh 6‑well plate with Matrigel® Matrix and incubate according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Add medium with ROCK inhibitor
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL of mTeSR1 medium containing 10 µM ROCK inhibitor to each well of the coated 6‑well plate.

steps.title: Prepare recovery medium
steps.instruction: For each reaction, pre‑warm 70 µL of mTeSR1 medium with 10 µM ROCK inhibitor; keep on ice until use.

steps.title: Prepare Nucleofector solution
steps.instruction: Combine the entire Nucleofector™ Supplement with the Nucleofector™ Solution as described by the manufacturer, ensuring the mixture is less than 3 months old.

steps.title: Hydrate sgRNA and Cas9
steps.instruction: Hydrate 3 nmol of sgRNA in 30 µL 1X nuclease‑free TE buffer to obtain 100 µM (100 pmol/µL) sgRNA; prepare Cas9 nuclease at 20 µM (20 pmol/µL).

steps.title: Assemble RNP complexes
steps.instruction: Mix sgRNA and Cas9 according to the proportions given in the protocol table for a single reaction (scale up as needed). Incubate the RNP mixture at room temperature for 10 minutes, then place on ice until use.

steps.title: Detach cells with Accutase
steps.instruction: Add pre‑warmed Accutase® to the iPS‑cell plates and incubate at 37 °C for 3–5 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Gently pipette the suspension up and down 4–6 times to obtain a single‑cell suspension.
Add an equal volume of mTeSR1 medium to neutralize Accutase®.
Collect the cells into an appropriately sized tube.

steps.title: Count and aliquot cells
steps.instruction: Take an aliquot of the detached cells, count them, and determine density; transfer exactly 5 × 10⁵ cells per reaction into a Corning® 15 mL centrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 115 × g for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant completely, taking care not to disturb the loosely packed pellet.

steps.title: Wash cells with PBS
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 5 mL PBS buffer and wash by gently pipetting up and down; centrifuge again at 115 × g for 3 minutes at room temperature and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend cells in P3 solution
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed cells in Lonza P3 Nucleofector™ solution at 20 µL per reaction. Work quickly, keep the cells in solution ≤15 minutes, and avoid bubble formation.

steps.title: Mix cells with RNPs
steps.instruction: Combine 20 µL of the cell suspension with 5 µL of the prepared RNP mix (from Step 7) for each reaction in a suitable tube or plate.

steps.title: Load mixture into Nucleocuvette
steps.instruction: Transfer the 25 µL cell‑RNP mixture to each well of a Nucleocuvette™ strip, click the lid closed, and gently tap the strip on the benchtop to ensure full coverage and eliminate bubbles.

steps.title: Electroporate cells
steps.instruction: Place the sealed Nucleocuvette™ strip into the retainer of the 4D‑X Core unit, confirming orientation (larger cutout = top, A1/A2; smaller = bottom, H1/H2). Run the electroporation program “CA137” and press Start; a green “+” on the screen indicates successful transfection. Remove the strip after the run.

steps.title: Add recovery medium
steps.instruction: Using a multichannel pipette, add 70 µL of the pre‑warmed mTeSR1 + 10 µM ROCK medium (from Step 4) to each well of the Nucleocuvette™ strip to recover the cells.

steps.title: Transfer cells to 6‑well plate
steps.instruction: Move the contents of each well to the corresponding well of the pre‑coated 6‑well plate prepared in Step 2 and incubate overnight in a humidified 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator.

steps.title: Post‑electroporation culture
steps.instruction: Replace the medium with fresh mTeSR1 (without ROCK inhibitor) 24 hours after nucleofection and then change daily until cells are harvested. Continue incubation for an additional 4 days in a humidified 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator.

steps.title: Analyze editing efficiency
steps.instruction: Assess genome editing by PCR, Sanger sequencing, and ICE analysis; optionally perform next‑generation sequencing, FACS, or functional assays. If desired, split the culture into one portion for analysis and one for continued growth.
